storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from heat and moisture: up to 1–2 years whole. Crack the pod only just before use.
looksLike: A large, dark-brown to almost black pod, about 2–5 cm long, rough and wrinkled with ridges, much bigger than green cardamom. The sticky black seeds inside have a strong smoky, camphor-like smell from being dried over fire.
shelfLife: About 1–2 years whole in a sealed pack; the seeds lose aroma quickly once crushed.

usedIn.raw: 1 pod, lightly crushed, tempered in ghee
